title: Olu nke iguzosi ike
intro: A na-echeta onye a maka amamihe na nduzi miri emi, na-enye ndụmọdụ karịrị ọgbọ dị iche iche. Okwu ha na-egosi nsọpụrụ Chineke na mkpa ọ dị ịmata ngọzi na ọnwụnwa sitere n'aka Chineke. Chọpụta njirimara nke mkpụrụ obi a a na-asọpụrụ.
clues: Abụghị m onye amụma, mana amamihe m dị ndụ n'ime Akwụkwọ Nsọ.
Ndụmọdụ m nyere nwa m mesiri ike ikele Allah na izere ihere.
Akụziri m mkpa ekpere dị, inye iwu maka ihe ọma, na igbochi ihe ọjọọ.
Adọọla m aka ná ntị megide mpako na ije ije n'elu ala.
Aha m bụ otu isiakwụkwọ dum dị na Quran, nke na-akọwa ozizi m.
Ndụmọdụ m gụnyere ndidi n'ihe isi ike, n'ihi na n'ezie, nke ahụ sitere n'ihe kacha sie ike.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
